heading: American National Red Cross: detail of commissioned officers
lead: Commissioned officers of the Army, Navy, and Air Force may be detailed for duty with the American National Red Cross, by the Secretary of the military department concerned, as follows:

tree.text: for duty with the Service to the Armed Forces Division—

children.text: one or more officers of the Army Medical Department;
one or more officers of the Medical Department of the Navy; and
one or more officers selected from among medical officers, dental officers, veterinary officers, medical service officers, nurses, and medical specialists of the Air Force; and

tree.text: to be in charge of the first-aid department—

children.text: an officer of the Medical Corps of the Army;
an officer of the Medical Corps of the Navy; or
a medical officer of the Air Force.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1980—Pub. L. 96–513 struck out “(a)” before “Commissioned”. 1968—Subsec. (a)(1)(A). Pub. L. 90–329 substituted “Army Medical Department” for “Army Medical Service”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1980 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 96–513 effective Dec. 12, 1980, see section 701(b)(3) of Pub. L. 96–513, set out as a note under section 101 of this title.
